name: GTA VI 100% Completion: Full Checklist & Route
summary: All 35 launch checklist requirements, with counts, where to track progress, and a low-backtracking plan for finishing Leonida.
description: The in-game 100% Completion checklist becomes visible after the story at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Work completed before then still counts. This checklist is a defined subset of the game's content: it asks for 100 optional tasks, selected portions of many activity and collectible sets, and all items in a few specific categories. The checklist below follows the launch-era requirements reported by PowerPyx and independently cross-checked against GTABase. It is a fan reference, not an official Rockstar guide; check the in-game counter if a later patch changes a requirement.
estimatedTime: Plan for a long completion run; use the in-game tracker rather than a fixed hour estimate
requirements: Finish the story to reveal the 100% checklist; earlier progress is retained.
Use the in-game Progress menu and map filters to confirm counts. The archive's checklist is a companion, not synced to game saves.
Do optional tasks when convenient, scan vehicles with WAiNK, and study animals with binoculars while exploring.
You do not need every activity, side quest, collectible, or stunt in the game; follow the thresholds below.
If also pursuing trophies, keep a separate save before Chapter 1 ends and consult the trophy roadmap for a potentially missable meditation.

steps.title: Story completion — finish the main story
steps.content: Complete the main story through its ending. This is the largest single checklist component. Progress is counted as you play, but the 100% checklist page itself only appears after the story.
steps.tip: Keep a manual save at chapter boundaries if you want to revisit story content; launch guides report no mission replay.

steps.title: 100 optional tasks
steps.content: Complete any 100 optional tasks. Side jobs, optional missions, certain deliveries, activities, and other map tasks contribute. You do not need every optional mission; this threshold is usually reached while working through the rest of the list.
steps.tip: Use the map's activity and exploration filters and the Progress menu to see what the game has counted.

steps.title: 39 / 39 Gang Operations
steps.content: Clear all 39 Gang Operations by completing the operation and collecting its required valuables. Some are revealed through story progress; inspect each map marker for its remaining objective count.
steps.tip: Loot all marked valuables before leaving so you do not need to wait for a site to become available again.

steps.title: 22 / 22 Bank Jobs
steps.content: Fully complete the 22 Bank Jobs. Check the robbery marker's objective list and finish every required part of each job; large banks have additional vault objectives when unlocked.
steps.tip: Bank Jobs open as story systems become available. Return to incomplete markers rather than assuming a robbery counted when the escape began.

steps.title: 7 / 7 Payday Loan Jobs
steps.content: Finish every Payday Loan Job. These are tracked separately from other store robberies in the robbery map filter and Progress menu.
steps.tip: After the job unlocks, complete each listed location once and confirm its icon changes to the completed state.

steps.title: 34 / 35 Smash 'N' Grabs
steps.content: Complete any 34 of the 35 Smash 'N' Grabs. The category includes pawn and jewelry store robberies. A location can require both the public display and a back-room safe to register as complete.
steps.tip: Read the objective count on the map pin before you leave a store.

steps.title: 50 / 91 Stick Ups
steps.content: Complete Stick Ups at any 50 of the 91 tracked businesses. Use the Stick Ups filter under Robberies and choose nearby uncompleted shops.
steps.tip: The requirement is unique locations, not 50 robberies at one shop.

steps.title: Fence $100,000 in narcotics
steps.content: Sell narcotics to a fence until the Progress counter reaches $100,000. Loot from activities and discoveries can contribute; confirm the fence category before selling if you are tracking the total closely.
steps.tip: Do not confuse the value of goods carried with the amount recorded as fenced.

steps.title: Fence $100,000 in jewelry
steps.content: Sell jewelry to a fence until the dedicated jewelry counter reaches $100,000. Fencing stolen goods is a progression system, so check which buyers are available as the story advances.
steps.tip: Check the in-game counter after each sale; different goods are counted separately.

steps.title: Fence $250,000 in marked bills
steps.content: Fence marked bills until their tracked total reaches $250,000. This objective is separate from cash registers and other stolen property.
steps.tip: Complete the relevant story unlocks before repeatedly searching for this category of loot.

steps.title: 8 / 8 Vaults
steps.content: Hit all eight bank vaults and satisfy each vault's listed objective. Vaults are a distinct requirement from the 22 Bank Jobs and become available later in the story.
steps.tip: Do not count a standard bank robbery as a vault unless the vault objective is shown as complete.

steps.title: Fence $200,000 in vehicles
steps.content: Sell eligible stolen vehicles through the vehicle-fencing route until the tracked vehicle total reaches $200,000. Vehicle buyers and their requirements unlock over the campaign.
steps.tip: Inspect the buyer's terms and the car's tracker status before delivering; a car that cannot be accepted wastes a trip.

steps.title: 5 / 7 Kenton Sets
steps.content: Complete five of the seven Kenton treasure sets. Follow the set tracker and finish the required items in each set; two sets can be left incomplete for this checklist.
steps.tip: Do this alongside underwater exploration to reduce repeated trips to the coast.

steps.title: 15 / 18 Collectible Card Sets
steps.content: Find the cards needed to finish any 15 of the 18 sets. The complete card collection contains 480 unique cards, but all 18 sets are not required for 100%.
steps.tip: Track sets in Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards and finish nearby cards before crossing the map.

steps.title: 100 WAiNK Locations
steps.content: Scan any 100 scannable locations with the WAiNK phone app. Walk on foot when exploring: the game can alert you when a scannable landmark or curiosity is nearby.
steps.tip: Scan new objects as you encounter them instead of leaving this category to the end.

steps.title: 33 / 33 Underwater Discoveries
steps.content: Find all 33 underwater discoveries. These include sunken sites associated with Kenton's sets; track them in Progress > Collections > Exploration.
steps.tip: Pair each dive with the nearest coastline or island waypoint and bring a suitable watercraft.

steps.title: 30 / 34 Magazines, Books & Comics
steps.content: Collect any 30 of the 34 counted items: the category combines 27 magazines, books, and comics with seven book swaps. Duplicates do not add new unique entries.
steps.tip: Use the collection counter to distinguish a new item from another copy.

steps.title: 15 / 18 Meditation Spots
steps.content: Complete 15 of the 18 counted meditations. Some locations can count for both Jason and Lucia when you do the activity with each character.
steps.tip: The first home meditation is a separate potential trophy missable; it is not necessary for this 15-of-18 100% threshold.

steps.title: 100 / 125 Cocaine Flamingos
steps.content: Destroy 100 of the 125 collectible flamingo figures. The collectible counter distinguishes the target flamingos from decorative flamingos.
steps.tip: Check the map or tracker after a pickup rather than relying on appearance alone.

steps.title: 2 / 2 Unique Playlists
steps.content: Find both unique playlists. They are unlocked by scanning the associated posters; track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Unique Playlists.
steps.tip: The playlist collection may only appear in the menu after you discover the first one.

steps.title: 70 / 79 Discovered Styles
steps.content: Unlock any 70 of the 79 counted styles. This total combines tattoo styles obtained through WAiNK scans and collectible luxury watches.
steps.tip: Work from the in-game Discovered Styles list; it shows which style source remains incomplete.

steps.title: 30 / 40 Unique Races
steps.content: Win any 30 of the 40 unique races. Race markers appear as you explore; use Map > Activities > Racing and the race-group counters to find unfinished events.
steps.tip: Choose the classes and routes you handle best; only 30 unique wins are required.

steps.title: 10 / 13 Race Challenge gold medals
steps.content: Earn gold in any 10 of the 13 Race Challenges. Each challenge grades performance against its own time or score target.
steps.tip: Try a different vehicle or retry after learning the route. The threshold lets you skip three challenges.

steps.title: 42 / 42 Shooting Range gold medals
steps.content: Earn gold on all 42 Shooting Range challenge medals across the two ranges. Buy the range waiver where required, then complete each challenge's target score or time.
steps.tip: Use the Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges counters to isolate the challenge that remains.

steps.title: 4 / 4 Video Games
steps.content: Start all four playable video games. The checklist requires playing each one; it does not require a high score or finishing a full session.
steps.tip: Three are available at a home console and one is found at arcade cabinets; check the activity tracker for the fourth.

steps.title: 5 / 7 Pool opponents
steps.content: Defeat any five of the seven tracked pool opponents. Find them at their fixed venues and confirm wins under Progress > Activities > Sports > Pool.
steps.tip: Pick opponents near your current region so the activity fits into another trip.

steps.title: 2 / 3 Mini Golf locations
steps.content: Play a game at any two of the three mini-golf venues. Full-size golf courses do not count toward this specific requirement.
steps.tip: Use the Sports activity tracker to confirm you selected a mini-golf course.

steps.title: 90 / 100 Basketball hoops
steps.content: Score at 90 distinct basketball hoops. Repeating shots at the same hoop does not meet the unique-location count.
steps.tip: Filter the map for Basketball Hoops and clear them by region; the completed markers remain visible.

steps.title: 42 / 42 Drone Time Trials
steps.content: Complete all 42 Top Fun Drone Time Trials across 14 locations. The first two trials at each location require a par time; finishing the third trial unlock is enough for its checklist credit.
steps.tip: Use the drone activity filter and check each location's trial count in Progress.

steps.title: 300 / 397 Stunts
steps.content: Complete any 300 of the 397 stunt activities: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights, and 25 Base Jumps. Any combination counts.
steps.tip: Under the Bridges are a practical category to prioritize. A stunt's optional extra challenge is not required once the stunt itself registers.

steps.title: 70 / 80 Challenges
steps.content: Complete any 70 of the 80 tracked challenges. Check Progress > Challenges and pick easier remaining tasks rather than attempting every challenge.
steps.tip: This is also more than the amount needed for the launch trophy threshold.

steps.title: 15 / 15 Bret's Target Decks
steps.content: Complete all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. Follow his questline and the map's target-deck records to locate the remaining objectives.
steps.tip: This is one of the categories that requires its full listed count, so do not leave it until you expect a partial threshold.

steps.title: 200 / 277 Base Model Vehicles scanned
steps.content: Scan 200 of the 277 base model vehicles using WAiNK. Boats and aircraft can count; scanning vehicles as they appear during normal play reduces endgame cleanup.
steps.tip: The vehicle scan counter is separate from owning or driving the vehicle.

steps.title: 50 / 66 Standard Issue Weapons found
steps.content: Find any 50 of the 66 Standard Issue Weapons: 53 guns, nine melee weapons, and four explosives. Use the weapon discovery counter to identify missing classes.
steps.tip: A found weapon is what this criterion tracks; it does not require buying or customizing every weapon.

steps.title: 100 / 255 Animals studied
steps.content: Study any 100 of the 255 animals. Select binoculars, zoom in, and use the study action. Hunting and skinning are not required for this checklist item.
steps.tip: Study wildlife while travelling through different habitats; animal breeds are counted separately in the game's list.

commonMistakes: Treating this checklist as a demand to complete every collectible and side mission. Most entries have a partial threshold.
Leaving WAiNK scans and animal studies until after the story, which creates extra travel.
Assuming pre-story progress is lost because the checklist is hidden until the ending.
Confusing trophy missables with the 100% checklist. Some trophies can have separate missable conditions even when 100% cleanup remains available.
